regional_sources.supports: Both northern and southern flying squirrels occur in Minnesota; broad planing membrane extends front to hind feet, flattened tail and large eyes, tree-hollow/forest habitat.
regional_sources.fantasy_extension: The maple-key tail and samara-shaped autorotating patagia/seed-dispersal winds are original monster anatomy/powers, not documented squirrel behavior.

regional_sources.supports: Sugar-maple seeds form paired slightly connected winged samaras carried by wind; sugar maple grows in cool rich eastern Minnesota locations.
regional_sources.fantasy_extension: The creature borrows the paired seed-wing silhouette; it is neither a plant costume nor a claim of natural squirrel-controlled autorotation.
